lines.en: I skim out low across the water.
My pectoral fins open like two wings.
One beat of my tail and I rise.
I swim through the air with my tail.

lines.zh: 我从水面跃出，划一道弧。
lines.en: I leap from the surface in an arc.
The wind scrapes over my scales.
I fly low along the river.
I drop back into the water and spring out again.

lines.zh: 我在树梢的高度上掠过。
lines.en: I pass at treetop height.
My shadow moves over the water.
I twist once in the air.
I fly lower, nearer the wave tops.
I dash forward a short distance.
My scales flash in the sun.

lines.zh: 我落下的地方溅起水花。
lines.en: Water splashes where I land.

lines.zh: 我一路追着水面上的虫。
lines.en: I chase insects across the water.
I float at the surface, fins still spread.
Water flows past my gills.
I hover at the surface, fins trembling.
Half of me is under the water.
My fins fan gently.
A ring of ripples spreads on the water.
I stare at something floating.
I flick my tail and turn about.
The sun lights my back.
I work my tail to hold steady.
Several fish are moving below.
I lift my pectoral fins once.
These fins can glide quite far.
A little foam sits at my mouth.
I'll bite your reflection first.
I leap from the water, fins spread.
I can fly a short way, and I can bite.
I skim the surface and watch you.
I am not afraid of you coming closer.
I know these shallows well.
Fins like wings can glide a short way.

lines.zh: 我的鳍比我的身体还宽。
lines.en: My fins are wider than my body.
I am watching your reflection at your feet.
If you keep still, I will come close.
I roll over, one fin askew.
A tear opens in my winglike fin.
I thrash and dive for the water.
There is a little red in the splash.

lines.zh: 飞鱼离了水，鳃一张一合。
lines.en: Out of water, the flying fish's gills work and work.
The surface closes; I hide deep.
I am still swimming, only slower.
My fins hang limp.

lines.zh: 我的鳍一展，就从水面滑出去。
lines.en: Fins spread, I slide off the surface.
I rise a little again.
Something floats; I drift closer.
I swim over and take a look.
The smell is very faint.
I leap and miss.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转了两圈，才下嘴。
lines.en: I circle it twice before biting.

lines.zh: 我用鳍拨了一下，它没沉。
lines.en: I flick it with a fin; it doesn't sink.
That splash caught your hand, did it not?
This time I have it in my sights.
Too small to be worth a leap.
I take it and sink.
You touched my fin.

lines.zh: 我在水里翻了一下，鳍先出水。
lines.en: I flipped in the water, fins breaking the surface first.
We have churned the water badly.
I spring away to one side.
Your hand slid over my scales.
That startled me into a leap.
My fin brushed your boot.

lines.zh: 被撞了一下，我钻进水里。
lines.en: Knocked once, I dive under.
Rings spread on the water's face.
I surface again and look at you.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面追在你后面。
lines.en: I skim along the surface after you.
We leap out together.
The splash falls like rain.
Another of my kind is past the reeds.
This stretch of water is enough for two.
You fly a little higher than I do.

lines.zh: 我们落水的时候一起响。
lines.en: We strike the water together.
Do not swim too far. Keep up.
There are two shadows under the water.
We head upstream together.
I snap it up and dive.
It came apart in the water.

lines.zh: 它卡在石缝，我拨了出来。
lines.en: It's wedged in the rocks; I work it free.

lines.zh: 这东西，我在水里衔得动。
lines.en: This, I can carry in the water.
I leap from the water with it in my mouth.
It slipped away and I chase it.
I cannot swallow it. Too big.
Weed is caught on it.

lines.zh: 我用吻部把它顶回岸边。
lines.en: I nose it back toward the shore.
I swim off with it.
There is a shadow on the water.
Fins out, and I take flight.
I am ready to leap.
You are on the bank, within reach.
I will move into your reflection first.
I dip low, fins pulled taut.
I measure the distance — three of my lengths.
You bent to look into the water.
This time I will bite down.
Your heels are very near the water.
I draw nearer through the water.
Only my dorsal fin shows.

lines.zh: 你在水边的倒影很清楚。
lines.en: Your reflection at the water's edge is clear.
You crouch first, then I move.
The flash off my scales will catch your eye.
I can fly one stretch at a time.
The water is flat. Good for launching.
Your hand is moving in the water.
I time the wave and wait for it to fall.
Just this one stretch left.
I leap and strike your hand.
My teeth are small and close-set.

lines.zh: 我破水而出，撞在你胸口。
lines.en: I break the surface and hit your chest.
I bite and pull downward.
I leap from the water again.
You shook your hand and I was thrown off.
I fall back into the water with a splash.
Your cuff is soaked.
That only grazed the skin.
I am preparing another leap.
I leap up out of the water.
There is one more silver flash on the water.
Water still drips from my fins.
First I circle the surface.
A splash, and I'm here.
I land on the bank and bounce once.
My tail slaps the water loudly.
I come flying down from upstream.
The river is wide. I am at ease.
My landing in the water is quiet.
The heat has paled my scales.

lines.zh: 我从空中摔在岸上，弹不起来。
lines.en: I fall from the air onto the bank and cannot bounce.

lines.zh: 我在水里本该没事，可这次喘不上。
lines.en: Water is my home, yet this time I cannot breathe.
The water bursts and I am thrown clear.

lines.zh: 箭扎穿胸鳍，我掉了下来。
lines.en: An arrow pierced my pectoral fin and I dropped.
A cold force locks me up.

lines.zh: 水面上一只虫也没有了。
lines.en: There is not a single insect on the water.
Lightning skitters across the water.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我直往下掉。
lines.en: There is no water here, and I fall.
